title: Field and Hedgerow: Being the Last Essays of Richard Jefferies
sourceTitle: Field and Hedgerow: Being the Last Essays of Richard Jefferies
author: Richard Jefferies
description: "Field and Hedgerow: Being the Last Essays of Richard Jefferies" by Richard Jefferies is a collection of essays written in the late 19th century, posthumously compiled by his widow.
longDescription: This work reflects Jefferies’ deep appreciation for nature and the countryside, exploring themes related to the relationship between humans and the natural world, as well as observations on rural life, seasons, and the essence of existence.

authorInfo.bio: Richard Jefferies (1848–1887) wrote The Story of My Heart: An Autobiography. Their work forms part of the historical literary record preserved in this edition. The linked reference offers further details about their life and bibliography.
